definitionZh: 规则CSS的短手属性将多排网格,弹性,多列布局中行与列之间所绘制的线条的宽度,样式和颜色设定为相同值的列规则和行规则.
sourceDefinition: The rule CSS shorthand property sets the width, style, and color of the line drawn between rows and columns in multi-row grid, flex, and multi-col layouts, setting both the column and row rules to the same values.
